description: A horse tied to a no-AI happy ghast 11 blocks away, and a no-AI happy ghast tied to a fence knot 13 blocks away: the leashed happy ghast's snap and elastic distances (16 and 10) and the four-point leash between a quad holder and a horse (SHARED_QUAD_ATTACHMENT_POINTS, wrench scaled by 0.25); the ghast shows IS_LEASH_HOLDER (notifyLeashHolder).
